segments.caption: A GMC Certified Service technician stands before a blue backdrop next to a dark blue GMC pickup truck, introducing a service segment focused on tire replacement.

A GMC Certified Service representative, Dave Campbell, stands in front of a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck, delivering a presentation or testimonial in a studio setting with a blue curtain backdrop.

A GMC service technician, identifiable by his branded shirt, speaks to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC truck. The scene then transitions to a split-screen view showing a mechanic in a garage actively installing a new tire onto a vehicle's wheel, demonstrating a routine vehicle maintenance procedure.

A GMC service technician demonstrates the process of replacing a tire on a lifted vehicle, showing the removal of the old tire and the installation of a new one, while a GMC-certified service representative speaks to the camera in front of a GMC truck, likely explaining the service or maintenance procedure.

A GMC Certified Service technician speaks to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck, introducing a segment that visually compares healthy, deep tire tread with worn, deteriorated tread to emphasize the importance of tire maintenance.

The segment presents a side-by-side visual comparison of tire treads, labeled "Good Tread" and "Bad Tread," to illustrate the difference in wear. A text overlay appears, stating that GMC recommends rotating tires every 7,500 miles, reinforcing the importance of regular maintenance to prevent uneven wear and ensure safety.

This segment visually explains GMC's tire maintenance recommendations. It opens with a comparison showing the difference between "Good Tread" and "Bad Tread" to emphasize the importance of regular inspection. The main event then focuses on a close-up demonstration of using a tread depth gauge, where a hand carefully inserts the tool into the tire's tread to measure its depth, illustrating the practical method for checking tire wear and determining when rotation or replacement is needed.
A hand uses a tire tread depth gauge and then a penny to measure the tread depth of a tire, indicating a check for safety or wear.

A GMC service technician demonstrates how to check for tire tread wear by using a penny. He holds the coin upside down, with Lincoln’s head facing down, and presses it into the tire’s tread groove. The red arrow graphic highlights the action, showing that if the top of Lincoln’s head is visible, the tread is worn and the tire needs replacement.

A GMC service technician speaks to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck, introducing a topic. The scene then cuts to a close-up shot of a mechanic using a wrench to work on a vehicle's wheel hub assembly, illustrating a specific repair or maintenance procedure.

A close-up shot shows a mechanic using a wrench to tighten or loosen a bolt on the exhaust system near a car's wheel. The camera slowly pans and zooms out, revealing the shiny, multi-spoke alloy wheel and the vehicle's undercarriage, indicating the work is being performed on a car elevated on a lift in a garage or workshop.
A GMC service technician explains a vehicle maintenance procedure, using close-up shots of a wheel hub and a damaged road surface to illustrate the context of tire wear and road conditions.

A GMC service technician speaks to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC Sierra pickup truck, while a close-up shot of a cracked and sunken asphalt road is shown, likely illustrating a common vehicle maintenance or repair issue.

A GMC Certified Service representative speaks to the camera in front of a dark blue GMC truck, introducing the brand's certified service program. The video then transitions to show the "Certified Service" signage on a dealership building, followed by scenes of service advisors assisting customers with their vehicles, illustrating the professional, customer-focused nature of the service experience.

The video segment showcases a GMC Certified Service promotional presentation. It begins with a scene inside a dealership, where two women in uniform are demonstrating a vehicle, with one gesturing towards the open driver's side door. The scene then transitions to a man in a white "GMC Certified Service" shirt speaking directly to the camera, standing in front of a dark blue GMC truck against a blue backdrop. A lower-third graphic prominently displays the GMC logo and the website "gmccertified
